name: What common issues might arise during a single room renovation?

mainEntity.name: What common issues might arise during a single room renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common issues during a renovation include encountering unforeseen structural problems, outdated plumbing or electrical systems not up to current code, or unexpected material delays. Sometimes, homeowners also change their minds about design choices mid-project. A reputable contractor will anticipate many of these challenges, include contingency plans in the budget, and maintain open communication to address issues promptly, minimizing disruptions and additional costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues include unforeseen structural problems, outdated systems, or material delays. A good contractor plans for contingencies and communicates proactively.
